command: rg --json (retired paths, markers and all denial-ledger spellings) .

dispositions.historical behavior assertions or unrela: Legacy in test names/payloads describes historical assertions. Deprecated: fields are HTTP/OpenAPI metadata literals, not exported Go deprecation comments.
dispositions.historical checkout measurement generato: Old-style strings are emitted only for a separate retained historical checkout; never imported by this tree.
dispositions.historical notes or unrelated protocol t: Removal notes describe completed migration. Job envelope/JSON/metric wording describes retained wire or diagnostic behavior.
dispositions.unrelated supported protocol or storage: ErrLegacyLayout rejects retained Redis layout-1 data; DisableLegacyXSSFilter disables the obsolete browser filter; provider HMAC-SHA1 and file-cache names describe supported external recovery protocols, not retired data-layer APIs.

scope: All rg-visible files; this slice evidence excluded from its own census. The semantic guard independently scans every Go source without exemptions.
